home.title: About CottonCalc Pro
home.subtitle: All-in-One Cotton Ginning & Oil Mill Calculator
home.purpose: CottonCalc Pro provides instant, reliable calculation tools for cotton ginners, commodity traders, and oil millers. Accurately calculate ginning cost parity, reverse procurement rates, cottonseed crushing profitability, and oil cake production costs.
howToUse: Select your desired commercial module: Cotton Ginning or Oil Mill from the home cards.
Tap any of the interactive quick-launch badges on the cards (e.g. Parity, Reverse, Output, Khal Cost, Profit, Recovery) to jump straight to that specific tab.
Enter your lot weights and prevailing local market rates to receive instant break-even costs and yields.
Switch language (English, हिन्दी, ગુજરાતી) or appearance theme anytime from the top bar or settings page.
keyFeatures: Direct Tab Launchers: Interactive 3D pill badges on each card take you directly to your chosen calculation screen in 1 tap.
Comprehensive Commercial Suite: Covers seed cotton ginning outturn (GOT), lint parity, reverse buying rate, wash oil recovery, crushing P&L, and Khal cost.
Standard Indian Cotton Conversions: Built-in standards for 1 Candy (355.62 kg Lint), 1 Maund (20 kg), 1 Quintal (100 kg), and 1 Metric Ton (1000 kg).
Offline-First Progressive Web App: Install to your phone or desktop home screen and perform calculations anywhere with zero internet required.
importantFields: Cotton Ginning Module: Calculate GOT %, Candy cost of production (Parity), and maximum raw cotton buying rate.
Oil Mill Module: Track cottonseed crushing recovery %, net profit/loss per ton, and cost of production of Khal.
Standard Conversion Standards: 1 Candy = 355.62 kg Lint, 1 Maund = 20 kg Raw Cotton, 1 Ton = 1000 kg Seed.
Legal Notice & Disclaimer: Commercial decision-support estimates; always verify with weighbridge slips and lab test records.
actions: Launch Module: Tap any main card to enter that calculator.
Direct Tab Navigation: Tap any badge on the cards to open that exact tab.
Language & Theme Toggle: Quickly switch languages and dark/light mode from the top bar.
Install Application: Add CottonCalc Pro to your device for 1-tap offline use.
View Legal Disclaimer: Tap the disclaimer link at the bottom of any screen.

ginning.title: About Cotton Ginning
ginning.subtitle: Ginning Outturn (GOT) & Parity Calculations
ginning.purpose: Accurately test Ginning Outturn (GOT) percentage from seed cotton (Kapas) and compute Cost of Production (Parity) as well as Reverse Buying Parity for profitable purchasing decisions.
howToUse: Select your calculation tab: Parity (Cost per Candy), Reverse (Max purchase price), or Output (GOT test).
Choose measurement unit: Sample (g) for 100g laboratory sample tests or Bulk (kg) for commercial mill lots.
Enter Raw Cotton (Kapas) weight along with Lint and Seed outputs to calculate GOT % and waste automatically.
In Parity / Reverse tabs, enter market rates (Kapas rate, Seed price, Ginning expense) to compute instant break-even costs.
keyFeatures: Cost Parity Calculator: Computes net manufacturing cost for 1 Candy (355.62 kg) of lint after deducting seed revenue.
Reverse Buying Parity: Calculates the maximum price you can afford to pay per 20kg maund of Kapas to break even.
GOT Percentage Breakdown: Dynamic visual donut chart showing exact Lint %, Seed %, and Waste %.
Real-Time Balance Check: Warns immediately if total output does not equal 100%.
importantFields: Total Raw Cotton (Kapas): Total unprocessed seed cotton weight tested or processed.
Lint Output: Weight of clean, ginned cotton fiber recovered.
Seed Output: Weight of cotton seed separated from fiber during ginning.
Waste / Loss: Trash, dust, and moisture loss during ginning process.
GOT % (Ginning Outturn): Percentage of lint fiber extracted from Kapas (typically 32% - 36%).
Kapas Purchase Rate: Market price paid per 20kg maund or 100kg quintal of seed cotton.
Seed Selling Price: Market realization per 20kg maund or 100kg quintal of cotton seed.
Ginning Expense: Electricity, labor, bale bagging, and processing charges per 20kg maund.
Shortage / Waste %: Expected invisible process loss and moisture loss during ginning.
Cost of Production (/ Candy): Total cost to produce one candy (355.62 kg) of lint factoring in seed sales and ginning charges.
Reverse Buying Parity: Highest purchase rate you can pay per 20kg maund to avoid losses at current market rates.
actions: Tab Navigation: Seamlessly switch between Cost Parity, Reverse Parity, and GOT Output calculations.
Sample (g) / Bulk (kg) Toggle: Switch between gram lab testing and commercial kilogram lot processing.
Unit Selection: Switch Kapas and Seed rates between 20kg Maund and 100kg Quintal.

oil.title: About Oil Mill
oil.subtitle: Seed Crushing Recovery, Profit & Khal Cost
oil.purpose: Track cottonseed crushing recovery (Wash Oil, Oil Cake, and Loss), calculate net crushing profit or loss, and determine the exact production cost of Khal (Oil Cake).
howToUse: Select your calculation tab: Khal Cost (Cost per unit), Profit (Net P&L), or Recovery (Yield breakdown).
Enter Total Seed Processed (kg), Wash Oil Recovery %, and Cake (Khal) %.
Review dynamic Output Breakdown cards for exact yields in kilograms and percentages.
In Profit & Khal Cost tabs, enter market rates (Seed purchase, Oil selling, Cake selling, and Processing expense) to view instant profitability.
keyFeatures: Khal Production Cost: Computes exact manufacturing cost of Oil Cake across selectable unit sizes (50kg Bag, 20kg, 100kg, 1kg).
Crushing Profit/Loss Analysis: Automatically computes total revenue against total cost with clear profitability status.
Dynamic Recovery Breakdown: Real-time calculation of Wash Oil (kg), Oil Cake (kg), and Waste/Moisture loss.
Visual Status Badges: Instant feedback indicating profitable or loss-making operations.
importantFields: Total Seed Processed: Total raw cottonseed fed into expellers/crushing plant.
Oil Rec. %: Percentage of unrefined Wash Oil extracted (typically 10% - 13%).
Cake (Khal) %: Percentage of solid protein cake produced (typically 82% - 86%).
Waste / Loss: Moisture evaporation and invisible process loss.
Seed Purchase Rate: Purchase price per 20kg maund, per ton, or per 100kg.
Oil Selling Rate: Market selling price of unrefined wash oil per 10kg, 1kg, or 15kg tin.
Cake (Khal) Selling Rate: Market selling price of oil cake per 50kg bag, 20kg, 100kg, or 1kg.
Processing Expense: Electricity, maintenance, labor, and steam expense per 20kg maund (default) or per metric ton.
Net Crushing Profit / Loss: Total oil and cake realization minus total procurement and crushing cost per metric ton.
Khal Cost of Production: Net manufacturing cost to produce one unit of oil cake after deducting wash oil revenue.
actions: Tab Navigation: Switch between Khal Cost, Profit, and Recovery calculators.
Seed Buy Unit: Switch purchase unit between 20kg, 100kg, and Ton.
Oil Sell Unit: Switch oil selling unit between 10kg, 1kg, and 15kg tin.
Cake Sell Unit: Switch cake selling unit between 50kg Bag, 20kg, 100kg, and 1kg.
Show Cost Per Unit (Khal Cost): Choose display unit (50kg Bag, 20kg maund, 100kg quintal, 1kg).

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.subtitle: Legal Notice & Terms of Use
disclaimer.intro: Cotton Calculator Pro is for estimation and reference only. All results are calculated from the values you enter and standard formulas. They are not guaranteed.
disclaimer.point1Desc: Outturn, lint, seed, oil and cake yields depend on cotton variety, moisture, trash content, seed quality, machinery condition and processing practices. Real figures at your gin or mill may differ from these estimates.
disclaimer.point2Desc: The app does not provide live market prices. Verify rates, charges, taxes and duties before you use them in any deal.
disclaimer.point3Desc: Nothing in this app is a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any commodity. Trading and processing decisions are your own responsibility.
disclaimer.point4Desc: Confirm important figures independently, with your own records, weighbridge slips, lab reports or advisors, before you commit to contracts, payments or invoices.
disclaimer.point5Desc: The developer is not responsible for any loss, damage or dispute arising from use of, or reliance on, this app or its results.
disclaimer.acceptance: By using this app, you accept these terms.
